recognize_zh: 淋巴結結構被大量融合的非壞死性肉芽腫與玻璃樣變纖維取代；高倍下多核巨細胞內可見星芒狀嗜酸性的星狀體（asteroid body，箭頭尖）與黃褐色卵圓形的 Hamazaki-Wesenberg 小體（箭頭），流式顯示無淋巴腫瘤且 CD4:CD8 比例顯著升高，符合類肉瘤病淋巴結病變。
features: Low power: lymph node architecture effaced by innumerable coalescent nonnecrotizing granulomas with hyalinized fibrous stroma
Tight epithelioid granulomas containing numerous multinucleated giant cells, rimmed by small lymphocytes
Giant cells with star-shaped eosinophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions (asteroid bodies, arrowhead) and clear/vacuolated cytoplasm
Small ovoid yellow-brown intracytoplasmic Hamazaki-Wesenberg bodies (arrow)
No caseous necrosis in the sampled fields
Flow cytometry: CD4-predominant T cells (CD4:CD8 markedly elevated) and polytypic CD19+ B cells (kappa:lambda ~1.1)
describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement of the architecture by numerous coalescent, well-formed nonnecrotizing epithelioid granulomas with intervening hyalinized fibrosis. The granulomas contain abundant multinucleated giant cells, some harboring star-shaped eosinophilic asteroid bodies, and there are small ovoid yellow-brown Hamazaki-Wesenberg bodies. No necrosis is identified. Flow cytometry shows no immunophenotypic evidence of a lymphoma, with CD4-predominant T cells and polytypic B cells. With negative AFB, Fite and GMS stains, findings are consistent with sarcoid lymphadenopathy.

ddx.vs: Infectious granulomas are usually necrotizing and organisms are demonstrated with AFB/Fite/GMS stains or culture, which were negative here.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or T-cell lymphoma with granulomatous reaction
ddx.vs: Would show Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) or atypical clonal lymphocytes between granulomas; flow and morphology show none.

ddx.dx: Sarcoid-like reaction to carcinoma or drugs (e.g., checkpoint inhibitors)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; distinction relies on finding a tumor elsewhere or drug history.
Foreign body granulomas contain polarizable material and beryllium disease requires exposure history and lymphocyte proliferation testing.
